name: Container Distribution Framework 3.1.0 - Skyrim 1.7.104 native overlay

verification: SKSE version data reports version-independent format-5 support.
No MessageBoxA, MessageBoxW, or report_and_fail symbol/string is present.
Runtime merchant/nonmerchant onlyVendors behavior remains pending.
The live binary overlay now includes the full Apache-2.0 license and a source/modified-file notice naming the exact fork commit and build PR.
